# Tier B Linux host only (finding F-27; tests/README.md section 11.13). prototype, unpromotable.
# The host-side helpers (validate, export-gsm8k, verify-export, nel-config, merge-eval,
# tierb-collect, impact) need no torch, and this file has none: `gatedtrain run`, `warmup` and the
# Tier A tests are not available on the host. uv.lock covers macOS only (G-11), so the host
# installs these exact pins instead of `uv sync --locked`. Every version must equal its uv.lock
# entry; scipy's only locked dependency is numpy, cryptography's are cffi and pycparser. Update both together.
# Each pin carries the SHA-256 of every distribution PyPI publishes for that version (generated with
# `uv pip compile requirements-tierb-host.txt --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --python-version 3.13
# --only-binary :all: --generate-hashes`); the host installs with `--require-hashes`.
